calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) d, count(*) n, count(distinct o.web_order_id) dn,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.status<>'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noncancel,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_noncancel
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (
 SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
 WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled'
)
SELECT count(*) orders,
 count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) dist_orders,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_orders,
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND s.store_id=999) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND s.store_id<>900) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonweb_store
FROM o

SELECT web_order_id, member_key, login_state, order_ts_utc, dispatch_ts_utc, status, order_total_gross, line_count, count(*) over (partition by member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross) dup
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
QUALIFY dup>1 OR order_total_gross<=0 OR line_count<=0 OR order_ts_utc IS NULL
LIMIT 50
